# ZS Digitizing

> ZS Digitizing provides professional embroidery digitizing, raster to vector conversion, and custom patch services for businesses, brands, apparel companies, and individual customers worldwide.

## About ZS Digitizing

ZS Digitizing specializes in turning artwork, logos, and creative designs into production-ready files for embroidery and print applications. Our work focuses on clean detailing, reliable file quality, practical stitch planning, and fast turnaround.

With 10+ years of experience and more than 13,000 completed orders, we help customers prepare artwork that is ready for real-world production.

## Services

- [Embroidery Digitizing](https://www.zsdigitizing.com/services/embroidery-digitizing): Professional embroidery digitizing for logos, caps, jackets, uniforms, apparel, appliqué, and detailed embroidery designs.
- [Raster to Vector Conversion](https://www.zsdigitizing.com/services/rastertovector): Conversion of raster images and low-resolution artwork into clean, scalable vector artwork suitable for printing, branding, embroidery, and other production needs.
- [Custom Patches](https://www.zsdigitizing.com/services/custom-patches): Custom embroidered, woven, PVC, chenille, and leather patch services for brands, businesses, apparel, clubs, teams, and organizations.

## Embroidery Digitizing

ZS Digitizing creates embroidery files with production in mind. Designs are prepared with appropriate stitch types, stitch direction, density, underlay, pull compensation, and sequencing to help achieve clean and consistent embroidery results.

Common embroidery digitizing projects include:

- Business and brand logos
- Left chest logos
- Cap and hat embroidery
- Jacket embroidery
- Uniform embroidery
- Names and lettering
- Appliqué designs
- Detailed artwork
- Large embroidery designs
- Custom embroidery files

## Raster to Vector Conversion

Raster to vector conversion transforms pixel-based artwork such as JPG, PNG, screenshots, and low-resolution logos into scalable vector artwork.

Vector artwork can be resized without losing quality and is useful for:

- Logo printing
- Signage
- Apparel printing
- Branding materials
- Embroidery preparation
- Large-format artwork
- Marketing materials

Available vector formats may include AI, EPS, PDF, SVG, and CDR depending on the project requirements.

## Custom Patches

ZS Digitizing offers custom patch artwork and production services for different applications and materials.

Patch options include:

- Embroidered patches
- Woven patches
- PVC patches
- Chenille patches
- Leather patches

Customers can use custom patches for clothing brands, uniforms, clubs, teams, businesses, events, merchandise, and promotional products.

## Process

Our process is designed to keep projects simple and efficient:

1. Send your artwork or design requirements.
2. Our team reviews the artwork and production requirements.
3. The artwork is prepared using the appropriate production techniques.
4. The completed file is checked for quality and usability.
5. The final production-ready files are delivered to the customer.
